about_short_description.short_description: Tamarind Bio is a software company that help the scientists and researchers using computational tools in biology.

product.name: Boltz-1
product.description: An open-source machine learning model for biomolecular structure prediction matching AlphaFold3 performance without commercial use restrictions.

product.name: Boltz-2
product.description: An open-source model that predicts protein structures and binding affinities with free-energy-perturbation accuracy at high speed.

product.name: Boltzdesign1
product.description: A protocol for designing de novo binders to proteins, small molecules, nucleic acids, and post-translational modifications using AI and structure prediction.

product.name: Antibody Engineering Suite
product.description: Tools for structure prediction, design, optimization, and docking of antibodies and nanobodies targeting specific antigens.

product.name: Enzyme Engineering Platform
product.description: A platform for designing, optimizing, and modeling enzymes with multiple property targets using machine learning and molecular dynamics.

identifier.value: Small Molecule Discovery and Design Suite

product.name: Small Molecule Discovery and Design Suite
product.description: Computational tools for simulating, analyzing, and designing small molecule compounds and their interactions with protein targets.
